lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Hey Alex, do you have a minute to talk about the market booth?

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Sure. What's going on with it?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: The city moved us from the corner spot to the back row by the parking lot.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Since when? Nobody told me about that.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: The email came on Tuesday. I think it only went to the board.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Okay. So what do you want to do about it?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: I want to ask for the corner back, because most of our sales come from people walking past.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: That makes sense, but the permit office closes at four on Fridays.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Then I can call them tomorrow morning before my shift starts.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Ask them about the power outlet too. The freezer needs one.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Good point. The ice cream sold out by noon last time because the freezer kept tripping.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Right. And if they say no, we could share the corner with the bakery.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Maria already told me she would split the space and the cost with us.

lines.speaker: Alex
lines.text: Great. Send me what they say, and I will update the schedule.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Will do. Thanks for sorting this out with me.
